blockers:
1. [blocking] docs/usage.md:151 and :67: "Pass `--subagent-cache-ttl 5m` to setup" and "`1h` (or the flag)" fail after the first setup. `applyDefaults` keeps existing values (json-file.ts:206-207, settings.ts:97-98), so the flag reports `~ kept`. Only "edit the key" works.
2. [blocking] docs/usage.md:145: the branches and merges default gives what and why but no way to change it. README.md:27 ("a way to change it") overclaims.
3. [blocking] docs/usage.md:109 and :101: confinement leaves the plugin enabled user-wide. The Install steps (usage.md:24-25) carry no `--scope`, and no step turns that install off. usage.md:103 admits `--undo` does not disable it.
4. [blocking] docs/usage.md:30: "Until it has run … whenever `ctx7` or a key is missing" implies the line stops. `setupNotice` checks only user settings (check.ts:20), so after `--scope project|local` it repeats every session.
5. [blocking] docs/usage.md:58: "It touches no other file" is false. Setup writes `holyagent/setup-records.json` (record.ts:30-31, 65; settings.ts:107-110).
6. [blocking] docs/usage.md:141 and docs/decisions.md:19: "the root's measured growth sits in the high-g scenarios" is inference. The source gives 365–747k as context size and only "suggests" high g (assignment-0mw0n5dbt-lx2v.md:44). No growth rate was measured.
